_readme: UPDATE THIS EVERY YEAR based on the official Presidential Proclamations. List the movable / proclaimed holidays here: Eid'l Fitr, Eid'l Adha, Chinese New Year, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, and any special non-working day. An entry here REPLACES the app's generated holiday with the same name in the same year. Do NOT list fixed-date holidays (Jan 1, Dec 25, ...) or National Heroes Day: the app generates those. Bump "updated" every time you edit this file: the app only accepts a downloaded copy whose "updated" date is the same or newer than the one built into it.
